en.dr-ali-peiravi: 3-210 (The compiler of the book narrated) that his father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Sa’ed ibn Abdullah quoted Hammad ibn Ya’la ibn Himad, on the authority of his father, on the authority of Hammad ibn Isa al-Jahani, on the authority of Hurayz ibn Abdullah, on the authority of Zurarah ibn A’ayan that Abi Ja’far al-Baqir (MGB) said, “
A believer’s amusement is in three things: enjoying his women; joking around with his brethren; and praying at night.”
